source: pred.gg perk catalog (perks query); icons snapshotted to ui/img/eternals/<id>.webp and ui/img/eternals/<name>.webp for majors

638.name: Thraex
638.description: Basic Attacks <EffectText>Mark</> an Enemy Hero for <EffectText>3s</>. You deal <EffectText>+3% (+0.4% per level) Damage</> to them and take <EffectText>1.5% (+0.35% per level) less Damage</> from them.

minors.name: Alpha's Court
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>+6% Damage</> when no Allied Hero is within <EffectText>800 Units</>.

minors.name: Savage Strikes
minors.description: Deal <AttackDamageText>2 (+0.4 per Level) Physical Damage</> <EffectText>On-Hit</>. Attacking an Enemy Hero <EffectText>increases</> this by <AttackDamageText>100%</> for <EffectText>3s (Max 3 Stacks)</>. <HealthText>Heals</> for the <AttackDamageText>Damage</> dealt.

minors.name: The King
minors.description: Basic Attacks on Enemy Heroes grant <GoldText>6 Gold</>.

minors.name: Ferocity
minors.description: Gain <AttackDamageText>+1% Total Attack Speed</> <EffectText>per Second</> in <EffectText>Hero Combat</>. <EffectText>Stacks infinitely</> and resets when <EffectText>Out of Combat</>.

minors.name: Golden Mane
minors.description: Take <EffectText>8% less Damage</> from <EffectText>Non-AoE Attacks</>.

minors.name: Rallying Roar
minors.description: Gain <EffectText>+10 Ultimate Haste</>. Casting your <EffectText>Ultimate</> grants you and Allies within <EffectText>1500 Units +25% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>4s</>.

641.name: Vermis
641.description: Landing 3 Basic Attacks on an Enemy Hero within <EffectText>2.5s</> deals <HealthText>3%</> <EffectText>(+0.25% per Level)</> <HealthText>Max Health</> as <AttackDamageText>Physical Damage</> <EffectText>On-Hit</>.

minors.name: Crush
minors.description: <CC_Text>Immobilizing</> an Enemy Hero deals <HealthText>8% Max Health</> as <AttackDamageText>Bonus Physical Damage</> (<EffectText>8s</> CD per Target).

minors.name: Mechadrive
minors.description: Basic Attacks reduce your <EffectText>Secondary Ability’s Current Cooldown</> by <EffectText>10% On-Hit</>. Reduced to <EffectText>5%</> against Non-Heroes.

minors.name: Serration
minors.description: <EffectText>Vermis</> deals an additional <AttackDamageText>(+3.5% Target's Missing Health) Damage</>.

minors.name: Breach
minors.description: <EffectText>Ultimate</> Damage <EffectText>reduces</> an Enemy Hero's <ArmorText>Physical Armor</> by <ArmorText>35%</> for <ArmorText>4s</>.

minors.name: Melting Point
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>+10% Damage</> to Targets with more than <ArmorText>125 Physical Armor</>.

minors.name: Sub-Surface
minors.description: Take <EffectText>7% less Damage</> from <EffectText>AoE Abilities</>.

646.name: Krix
646.description: Gain <HealthText>5%</> <EffectText>(+1% per Level)</> <HealthText>Max Health</> and <EffectText>Bonus Size</> equal to <EffectText>0.5%</> of your <HealthText>Max Health</>.

minors.name: Festering Wounds
minors.description: Your <EffectText>DoT abilities</> and <CC_Text>Immobilizing Effects</> reduce Enemy Heroes' <HealthText>Healing</> by <HealthText>45%</> for <HealthText>2s</>.

minors.name: Regenerative Tissue
minors.description: After not taking Hero Damage for <EffectText>8s</>, <HealthText>regenerate 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health</> <EffectText>per Second</>.

minors.name: Voracity
minors.description: <HealthText>Heal 0.75% Max Health</> and gain <GoldText>+3 Gold</> on <EffectText>Unit</> kills.

minors.name: Cannibalism
minors.description: Takedowns <EffectText>permanently</> grant <HealthText>+35 Max Health</>.

minors.name: Feeding Frenzy
minors.description: Gain <AttackDamageText>+12% Attack Speed</> per Enemy Hero within <EffectText>1200 Units</>.

minors.name: Predator
minors.description: <AbilityName>Camp Leader</> Kills grant <EffectText>+10% Damage</> and  <EffectText>+3% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>20s (100% Bonus Duration</> for <AbilityName>Epic Monsters</><EffectText>)</>.

649.name: Vesh
649.description: <EffectText>Ability Damage</> dealt to Enemy Heroes deals +<EffectText>7% (+0.4% per Minute)</> of that Damage as a <EffectText>3s DoT</>.

minors.name: Lich
minors.description: Gain <AbilityPowerText>8%</> <EffectText>(+0.5% per Level)</> <AbilityPowerText>Magical Lifesteal</>.

minors.name: The Tenth Seal
minors.description: At <EffectText>Level 10</>, gain <EffectText>+5% Ultimate Damage</> and <EffectText>+25 Ultimate Ability Haste</>.

minors.name: Tithe of Death
minors.description: Takedowns restore <ManaText>15% Max Mana</> and permanently grant <EffectText>2 Ability Haste</>. (Max: <EffectText>30 Ability Haste</>).

minors.name: Millennia
minors.description: Every <EffectText>60 Seconds</>, gain <EffectText>+1% Ultimate Damage</>.

minors.name: Mind Rot
minors.description: <EffectText>Vesh</> also deals <HealthText>2%</> of the <HealthText>Target's Current Health</> over the <EffectText>Duration</>.

minors.name: Phylactery
minors.description: Casting your <EffectText>Ultimate</> grants a <ManaText>15% Max Mana</> <EffectText>Shield</> and <EffectText>100% Cooldown Progression</> for <EffectText>3s</>.

654.name: Aion
654.description: Casting an Ability grants <ManaText>+1 Mana Regen</> for <ManaText>8s</> <EffectText>(Max 5 Stacks)</>. Additionally, gain <GoldText>Gold</> equal to <AbilityPowerText>6%</> of <AbilityPowerText>Ability Damage</> dealt to Enemy Heroes.

minors.name: Bottomless Vial
minors.description: Killing a River Buff <EffectText>restores</> a <EffectText>Potion charge</> and <EffectText>permanently</> grants <AbilityPowerText>5 Magical Power</>.

minors.name: Philosopher
minors.description: Every <EffectText>10s</>, gain <GoldText>5 Gold</>. Interval is reduced by <EffectText>Ability Haste</>.

minors.name: Sacrifice
minors.description: Damaging an Enemy Hero with an Ability regenerates <ManaText>2.5% Missing Mana</> over <ManaText>5s</>. On Hero Kill, regenerate <ManaText>20% Missing Mana</> over <ManaText>5s</>.

minors.name: Arcane Resonance
minors.description: <EffectText>Basic Ability Cooldowns</> and <EffectText>Philosopher</> progress <EffectText>+0.75%</> faster per  <ManaText>1 Mana Regen</> (Max <EffectText>50%</>).

minors.name: Perfection
minors.description: While above <HealthText>85% Health</>, gain <EffectText>+30 Ability Haste</>.

minors.name: Runic Focus
minors.description: Gain <AbilityPowerText>+0.15% Magical Power</> per <ManaText>1% Current Mana</>.

663.name: Demiurge
663.description: Gain <EffectText>+10% Item Stats</> (excluding Passives) and <EffectText>+10% Item Damage</>.

minors.name: Bio-Mechanical Fusion
minors.description: Gain <AttackDamageText>1 Physical Power</> per <AbilityPowerText>8 Magical Power</>.

minors.name: Construct
minors.description: Gain <HealthText>+10 Health</> and <EffectText>+1 Ability Haste</> per <EffectText>Level</>.

minors.name: Tri-Core
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>5% Damage On-Hit</>, randomly chosen from <AttackDamageText>Physical</>, <AbilityPowerText>Magical</> and <EffectText>True Damage</>.

minors.name: Bloatware
minors.description: Gain <EffectText>+0.5% Damage</> and <EffectText>+0.75% Damage Reduction</> per <EffectText>Item</>.

minors.name: Cursed Corrupted
minors.description: Convert every <CritChanceText>1% Critical Strike Chance</> into <EffectText>0.8 Ability Haste</>.

minors.name: Memory Leak
minors.description: Ability casts grant <ManaText>+5%</> of their <ManaText>Mana</> or <GoldText>Energy</> <EffectText>Cost</> as <EffectText>permanent</> <ManaText>Max Mana</>. At <ManaText>+500 Max Mana</>, gain <EffectText>+5% Movement Speed</>.

666.name: Lotus
666.description: Every <EffectText>2 Minutes</> and for each Takedown you achieve, randomly gain <EffectText>+1% Damage</>, <EffectText>+4 Ability Haste</>, <EffectText>+0.75% Movement Speed</>, or <HealthText>+1.5% Max Health</>.

minors.name: Early Bloom
minors.description: <EffectText>Level Up</> again at <EffectText>Level 12</>.

minors.name: Flawless
minors.description: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes <HealthText>heal</> you and Allies within <EffectText>1000 Units</> for <HealthText>8</> <AbilityPowerText>(+10% Magical Power)</> <EffectText>(Once per cast)</>.

minors.name: Masterpiece
minors.description: Kills grant <EffectText>+4% Damage</> and <EffectText>+5% Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>12s</>.

minors.name: Fragrance
minors.description: Deal <AbilityPowerText>+4% Magical Damage</> and <EffectText>+12% True Damage</> to Enemy Heroes within <EffectText>800 Units</>.

minors.name: Immaculate
minors.description: Gain <EffectText>+12% Damage Reduction</> while above <HealthText>85% Health</>.

minors.name: Prima Donna
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>+10% bonus Damage</> to Enemy Heroes, but take <EffectText>+6% Damage</> from <EffectText>all sources</>.

669.name: Exarch
669.description: <HealthText>Heals</> or <EffectText>Shields</> grant the Target (including self) <AttackDamageText>+10% Total Attack Speed</> and <AbilityPowerText>+10% Magic Damage</> <EffectText>On-Hit</> for <EffectText>4s</>.

minors.name: Illumination
minors.description: Gain <HealthText>Health Regen</> equal to your <ManaText>Bonus Mana Regen</>.

minors.name: Preservation
minors.description: <HealthText>Healing</> or <EffectText>Shielding</> you receive is <EffectText>increased</> by <EffectText>10%</>.

minors.name: Revelation
minors.description: Ability casts reduce <EffectText>Basic Ability Cooldowns</> by <EffectText>0.3s</>.

minors.name: Delayed Fate
minors.description: <EffectText>20%</> of <EffectText>Ability Damage taken</> is dealt as a <EffectText>3s DoT</> instead.

minors.name: Fervour
minors.description: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes <HealthText>heal</> you and Allies within <EffectText>1000 Units</> for <HealthText>2</> <EffectText>(+0.5 per level)</><AbilityPowerText>(+5% Magical Power)</>.

minors.name: Omnipresent
minors.description: Gain <EffectText>7% Movement Speed</> when <EffectText>Out Of Combat</>.

674.name: Marrow
674.description: <HealthText>Heal</> for <HealthText>6%/7%/8%/9%</> of damage dealt to <EffectText>Heroes</>, increased up to <HealthText>15%/20%/25%/30%</> based on your <HealthText>Missing Health</> (<EffectText>65% Effectiveness</> for <EffectText>AoE</> Attacks, <EffectText>15%</> against <EffectText>Monsters</>).

minors.name: Leech

minors.name: Taste of Iron

minors.name: Jealousy

minors.name: Roses
minors.description: Hero Kills increase <AbilityName>Marrow's</> <HealthText>Healing</> by <HealthText>50%</> for <HealthText>8s</>. Takedowns grant <GoldText>+20 Bonus Gold</> per previous Takedown. (Max: <EffectText>5</> Takedowns).

minors.name: The Maw
minors.description: <CritChanceText>Basic Attacks</> deal <EffectText>+10% Bonus True Damage</> against Targets below <HealthText>40% Max Health</>.

678.name: Idrisil
678.description: While above <HealthText>30% Max Health</>, gain <EffectText>15%</> increased <ArmorText>Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>Magical Armor</>. <EffectText>Falling below</> <HealthText>30% Health</> grants a <EffectText>4s Shield</> equal to <EffectText>150%</> of your <EffectText>Total Armors</>. <EffectText>(CD: 75-32.5s)</>

minors.name: Cold Hearted
minors.description: Receiving Basic Attack Damage from Enemy Heroes <EffectText>reduces</> their <EffectText>Movement Speed</> by <CC_Text>2%</> for <CC_Text>2s</> <EffectText>(Max 5 Stacks)</>.

minors.name: Frost Snap
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>+10% Damage</> to <CC_Text>Immobilized</> or <CC_Text>Slowed</> Targets.

minors.name: Mending
minors.description: After taking Hero Damage, <HealthText>restore 3/4/5/6% Missing Health</> over <HealthText>8s</>.

minors.name: Diamond Tip

minors.name: Glacier

minors.name: Icy Touch
minors.description: Basic Attacks <EffectText>reduce</> Enemy Hero <AttackDamageText>Attack Speed</> by <AttackDamageText>3%</> for <AttackDamageText>3s</> <EffectText>(Max 4 Stacks)</>.

690.name: Nihil
690.description: Damage a Hero to gain <AbilityName>Doom</> for <EffectText>3s</>. <AbilityName>Doom</> grants <AttackDamageText>1 Physical Power</>, <AbilityPowerText>2 Magical Power</>, <ArmorText>1 Physical Armor</> & <AbilityPowerText>1 Magical Armor</> every <EffectText>3s</> <AbilityName>Doom</> persists. Stats gain <EffectText>20% more effectiveness per Level & Takedown</>.

minors.name: From the Abyss
minors.description: <HealthText>Restore 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health</> <EffectText>per Second</> while in <EffectText>Hero Combat</> or <EffectText>Out of Vision</>.

minors.name: Growing Threat
minors.description: At <EffectText>18 Minutes</>, gain <EffectText>+12% Damage</> and <EffectText>+5% Omnivamp</>.

minors.name: Mana Siphon
minors.description: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes <EffectText>steal</> <ManaText>10 (+1% Target's Max Mana)</>.

minors.description: Enemy Heroes within <EffectText>800 Units</> that <EffectText>Dash</>, <EffectText>Leap</>, or <EffectText>Blink</> are <CC_Text>Slowed by 20%</> for <CC_Text>2s</>.

minors.name: Terror
minors.description: Gain <EffectText>+35% Damage Reduction</> vs. <AbilityName>Minions</> and <AbilityName>Monsters</>, and <EffectText>+20%</> vs. <EffectText>Towers</>.

699.name: Xyris
699.description: Deal <EffectText>+3% Damage</>. Deal an additional <EffectText>+0.4% Damage</> per <EffectText>10 Units</> killed, up to a limit of <EffectText>400</> Units.

minors.name: Dominance
minors.description: Takedowns <HealthText>restore 100 (+15% Missing Health) Health</>.

minors.name: Furor
minors.description: Entering <EffectText>Hero Combat</> grants <AttackDamageText>20% Total Attack Speed</> for <AttackDamageText>4s</>.

minors.name: Iron Will

minors.name: Cull the Weak
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>+7% Damage</> to <AbilityName>Minions</> and <AbilityName>Monsters</>. Restore <ManaText>1% Missing Mana</> on Unit kill.

minors.name: Eviscerate
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>+15% Damage</> to Targets above <HealthText>80% Health</>.

758.name: Pilow
758.description: Decrease your <EffectText>Size</> by <EffectText>10%</>. Upon casting an Ability, nearby Enemy Heroes within a <EffectText>600u</> radius are <CC_Text>Debuffed</>, causing them to deal <CC_Text>4%</> less <CC_Text>Damage</> for <CC_Text>3.5s</>, stacking up to <CC_Text>3</> times.

minors.name: Bioluminescence
minors.description: Enemies you damage take <EffectText>3% bonus Damage</> and are <EffectText>Revealed</> for <EffectText>4s</>.

minors.name: Diffusion
minors.description: Increases the Radius of <AbilityName>Pilow's</> <EffectText>Debuff Pulse</> by <EffectText>50%</> and the <EffectText>Duration</> by <EffectText>1.5s</>.

minors.name: Harmonic Currents
minors.description: Casting an Ability restores <EffectText>2%</> of your <HealthText>Missing Health</> and <ManaText>Missing Mana</>.

minors.name: Convection
minors.description: Gain <ArmorText>4 Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>4 Magical Armor</> for every active stack of <AbilityName>Pilow</> on nearby Enemy Heroes.

minors.name: Lil Sucker
minors.description: Basic Attacks <EffectText>steal 2%</> of the Target's <EffectText>Movement Speed</> for <EffectText>3s</>, stacking up to <EffectText>3</> times.

minors.name: Neurotoxin
minors.description: <AbilityName>Pilow</> additionally increases <EffectText>Damage</> Enemies take by <EffectText>2%</> per stack.

759.name: Weald
759.description: Damaging an Enemy Hero below <HealthText>30% Health</> fires <EffectText>4 (+1</> per <AttackDamageText>25% Bonus Attack Speed</><EffectText>) Projectiles</>, each dealing <EffectText>8 (+1 per Level) True Damage</> and applying <EffectText>On-Hit</> effects at <EffectText>30% Effectiveness</> (<EffectText>8s CD per Hero</>).

minors.name: Dryad's Boon
minors.description: Basic Attacks decrease Basic Ability Cooldowns by <EffectText>0.2s On-Hit</>.

minors.name: Forage
minors.description: Gain <GoldText>4</> additional <GoldText>Gold</> and <EffectText>4</> additional <EffectText>XP</> per <AbilityName>Minion</> or <AbilityName>Monster</> Kill.

minors.name: Natural Resistance
minors.description: <EffectText>Cleanse</> all <CC_Text>Crowd Control</> and gain <EffectText>+400 Tenacity</> when below <HealthText>25% Maximum Health</>. (<EffectText>Cleanse: 20s CD</>).

minors.name: Barkskin
minors.description: Deal <AttackDamageText>3</> <EffectText>(+1 per Level)</> <AttackDamageText>Physical Damage</> to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you. This <AttackDamageText>Damage</> triggers <EffectText>On-Hit</> Effects at <EffectText>50%</> effectiveness.

minors.name: Taproot
minors.description: Basic Attacks restore <HealthText>1</> <AttackDamageText>(+8% Bonus Physical Power)</> <HealthText>Health</> <EffectText>On-Hit</>.

minors.name: Wind-Rider
minors.description: Gain <AttackDamageText>20% Total Attack Speed</> for <EffectText>4s</> after using a <EffectText>Dash, Leap, Teleport</> or upon leaving <EffectText>Stealth</>.

764.name: Satariel
764.description: Takedowns grant a stack of <AbilityName>Fearless</>, up to <EffectText>6</> times. Your <HealthText>Max Health</> is reduced by <HealthText>6%</> (<HealthText>+4% Melee</><EffectText>/</><RageText>+6% Ranged</> per <AbilityName>Fearless</>). Gain <EffectText>+5% (+5%</> per <AbilityName>Fearless</>) <AttackDamageText>Physical Power</>, <AbilityPowerText>Magical Power</> and <AttackDamageText>Attack Speed</>. <AbilityName>Fearless</> stacks are lost on Death.

minors.name: Demonic Bargain
minors.description: Gain <GoldText>350</> additional <GoldText>Gold</> at <EffectText>Levels 1/0/13</>.

minors.name: Hellfire Strikes
minors.description: Basic Attacks deal <EffectText>3 (+1.5 per Level) True Damage On-Hit</>.

minors.name: Risen
minors.description: When at <EffectText>3</> or more <AbilityName>Fearless</> stacks, gain <EffectText>12% Omnivamp</>.

minors.name: Broken Wings
minors.description: Your Movement Speed cannot be <EffectText>altered</> by Items or Abilities.

minors.name: Psychosis
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>3.5% (+0.4% per Level) more Damage</> to the closest Enemy Hero but <EffectText>10% less Damage</> to any other Enemy Hero.

minors.name: Rite
minors.description: Abilities cost an additional <HealthText>5</> <EffectText>(+2.5 per Level)</> <HealthText>Health</> to cast but you permanently gain <EffectText>15 (+1 per Level) Ability Haste</>.

768.name: Rust
768.description: Basic Attacks and Abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of <AbilityName>Rust</> for <EffectText>5s</>. Each stack shreds <EffectText>2% (+0.2% per Level)</> <ArmorText>Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>Magical Armor</>, stacking up to <EffectText>4</> times. You gain <EffectText>75%</> of the <EffectText>Armors</> Shredded.

minors.name: Dampening
minors.description: Incoming Damage from Enemies farther than <EffectText>1100u</> is reduced by <EffectText>12%</>.

minors.name: Frequency

minors.name: Patina

minors.name: Fracture
minors.description: Deal <EffectText>4% (+0.3% per Level)</> more Damage against Enemies with the maximum amount of <AbilityName>Rust</> stacks.

minors.name: Peal
minors.description: Gain <EffectText>25 Ultimate Ability Haste</>. Upon casting your Ultimate, Basic Attacks and Abilities apply the maximum amount of <AbilityName>Rust</> stacks for <EffectText>4s</>.

minors.name: Resonant Repair
minors.description: Whenever you are <CC_Text>Immobilized</>, you <HealthText>restore 3%</> of your <HealthText>Maximum Health</> over <EffectText>4s</>.
